binding_exclusion.rule: No statistic, label, raw record, graph, action identity, or outcome from the 53 playbooks/1796 actions may influence a fitted parameter, feature/schema choice, calibration value, or primary seed before the one-time final evaluation.

allowed_sources: separately authorized historical DARPA provenance partitions with train membership fixed before formal evaluation
synthetic or reserved Mininet traces declared as training data before the evaluation manifest is frozen
forbidden_sources: any labels or outcomes derived from them
track_l_detector_train.split_unit: host/run/playbook boundary, never an individual event randomly split across partitions
fit_operations: encoder fitting only if a transform actually requires fitted statistics

track_l_calibration.purpose: freeze thresholds, alpha, K, solidification choices, and preprocessing acceptance criteria
allowed_sources: a separately reserved validation partition from approved non-formal data
synthetic/reserved Mininet smoke traces if declared before freeze
forbidden_sources: FA1B2de raws, labels, playbook IDs, or post-hoc formal outputs

track_l_final_fa1b2de_test.purpose: single final formal evaluation after all configuration is frozen
track_l_final_fa1b2de_test.post_eval_feedback: results may be reported but cannot alter the frozen run; any later iteration receives a new configuration identity and new held-out test plan
track_l_final_fa1b2de_test.retry_policy: no selective retries; infrastructure failure is logged and rerun only under the same frozen manifest with a new run ID

allowed_sources: reserved Mininet traces not in FA1B2de
non_scored_smoke.tuning_use: only if membership and use as calibration/training data were declared before freeze; otherwise validation only

leakage_controls.group_disjointness: Keep all events from a host/run/playbook group in exactly one partition.
leakage_controls.temporal_rule: Do not use future records from a run to construct training features for earlier records in another partition.
leakage_controls.identifier_rule: Do not encode playbook, action, or evaluation membership as a feature or ordering key.
leakage_controls.normalization_rule: Any fitted statistics must be computed on detector-train only; deterministic fixed constants in the adapted schema are not fitted.
leakage_controls.label_rule: Ground-truth labels are used only for the declared train/validation/test role and never as live sensor inputs.
leakage_controls.negative_sampling_rule: If needed, perform random negative sampling only within the approved training source using a predeclared seed and retain the sampling manifest; never resample formal test records.

track_l_protocol.architecture: same provenance-subgraph GNN family and Phase-II structure, with a newly trained input layer
track_l_protocol.checkpoint_lineage: new checkpoint; no loading, padding, projection, or warm-start from the packaged 21-input checkpoint
